context_requirements: BTK expression and active B-cell receptor signaling
Hematopoietic lineage (B cells, myeloid cells) with BTK-dependent survival
Presence of BTK-dependent autophosphorylation (Y223) and downstream PLCG2 activation
falsifiers: Reproducible BTK-dependent transcriptional changes in any of the nine cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Dose-dependent modulation of BTK target genes in these lines
Selective growth inhibition or apoptosis in these lines at 10 micromolar

evidence.supports: BTK inhibitor PLS-123 shows anti-tumor activity in mantle cell lymphoma, a B-cell lineage context
Selective BTK inhibitor CHMFL-BTK-01 arrests cell cycle and induces apoptosis in lymphoma cell lines
Ibrutinib shows anticancer efficacy in breast cancer cells, but this is likely off-target and not representative of BTK inhibition in the nine lines
Ibrutinib disrupts stem cell dynamics and induces oxidative stress in planarians, a non-human model
